title: An ESDS opened I-O and updated in place: ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL, READ then REWRITE
shapes: AIXA AIXAESU: SELECT LOG-FILE ASSIGN TO LOGUPD ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL; OPEN I-O LOG-FILE; READ LOG-FILE; REWRITE LOG-REC
asserts: The SELECT is one file_control fact (select LOG-FILE, assign LOGUPD, organization SEQUENTIAL, access_mode SEQUENTIAL, record_key null) with no alternate_keys and no relative_key; the program declares nothing that says ESDS, as for H-0078. DD LOGUPD names PROD.AIXA.LOG, the NONINDEXED cluster H-0082 defines. The program REWRITEs only after a successful READ and never DELETEs: a sequential file has no DELETE statement.
